zh.title: 阿曼航空與薩拉姆航空同日宣布換帥執行長
zh.summary: 阿曼航空CEO離任、薩拉姆航空新任CEO生效日期公布
body: 阿曼航空與薩拉姆航空於2026年8月20日同一天宣佈執行長變動。阿曼航空表示現任CEO康·科菲亞蒂斯將於9月1日卸任，由納賽爾·阿爾·夏吉接任；薩拉姆航空確認雅各布·阿爾·基尤米將於10月1日接替阿德裡安·漢密爾頓-曼斯。
在科菲亞蒂斯任內，阿曼航空淨虧損從2023年的1.03億里亞爾（約2.68億美元）減半至2025年的5220萬里亞爾（約1.358億美元），並實現15年來首次正EBITDA，達320萬里亞爾（約830萬美元）。

en.title: Oman Air and SalamAir announce CEO changes on same day
en.summary: Oman Air CEO steps down; SalamAir names new CEO effective 1 Oct
body: On 20 August 2026 Oman Air and SalamAir each announced a chief executive change. Oman Air said Con Korfiatis will step down on 1 September 2026, with Nasser Al Sharji taking over, while SalamAir confirmed Engineer Yaqoob bin Saif bin Hamoud Al Kiyumi will succeed Adrian Hamilton‑Manns as CEO from 1 October 2026.

During Korfiatis’s tenure Oman Air’s net losses roughly halved from 103 million Rials (US$268 million) in 2023 to 52.2 million Rials (US$135.8 million) in 2025, and the carrier recorded its first positive EBITDA in fifteen years, 3.2 million Rials (US$8.3 million) in 2025.

facts.claim: Oman Air announced on 20 August 2026 that CEO Con Korfiatis will step aside on 1 September 2026, to be succeeded by Nasser Al Sharji.
facts.sourceQuote: On August 20, 2026, Oman Air announced that, on September 1, 2026, its Chief Executive Officer (CEO), Con Korfiatis, will step aside from the airline’s top role. His post is going to be assumed by Nasser Al Sharji

facts.claim: SalamAir announced that Engineer Yaqoob bin Saif bin Hamoud Al Kiyumi will replace Adrian Hamilton-Manns as CEO from 1 October 2026.
facts.sourceQuote: Engineer Yaqoob bin Saif bin Hamoud Al Kiyumi will be replacing Adrian Hamilton-Manns as Chief Executive Officer, from 1 October 2026.

facts.claim: Oman Air’s net losses roughly halved between 2023 and 2025, from 103 million Rials (US$268 million) in 2023 to 52.2 million Rials (US$135.8 million) in 2025.
facts.sourceQuote: Net losses have roughly halved between 2023 and 2025, from 103 million Rials (US$268 million) in 2023 to 52.2 million Rials (US$135.8 million) in 2025.

facts.claim: Oman Air posted its first positive EBITDA in 15 years in 2025, amounting to 3.2 million Rials (US$8.3 million).
facts.sourceQuote: In 2025, Oman Air even posted the first positive EBITDA in the course of the last 15 years, of 3.2 million Rial (US$8.3 million).
